price_note: ~IDR 67,000/tCO2e (~US$4) average across 2025; negotiated-market volume 118,796 tCO2e year-to-date through Feb 2026. Domestic compliance-market price, not a blue carbon-specific figure.

platform: Hanoi Stock Exchange (HNX) — pilot exchange launched 29 Jun 2026
price_note: Allowance caps: 243.1M tCO2e (2025), 268.4M tCO2e (2026) across ~110 facilities (power, steel, cement). No trades reported yet since the HNX pilot exchange launched — participants still testing the system as of this update.
source_label: The Investor — Vietnam's carbon market sees no new trades after launch

price_note: A Department Circular sets out carbon credit trading guidelines; credits must be verified and authorized through the Designated National Authority before counting as ITMOs or CORSIA allowances. No domestic trading platform or market price data found.
source_label: Reccessary — Philippines charts carbon credit framework to link with Article 6 of Paris Agreement

price_note: Phase 4 (2026–2030) National Emission Allowance Allocation Plan approved Nov 2025. Allowance prices rose ~50% over the 6 months leading into Nov 2025 ahead of the tighter cap; the market newly opened to securities firms.
source_label: Eco-Business — South Korea opens carbon trading to securities firms in major market overhaul

price_note: Became mandatory from FY2026 (previously voluntary baseline-and-credit, FY2023–FY2025), covering ~60% of national emissions (~600 MtCO2e). FY2026 price band: ¥1,700 floor / ¥4,300 ceiling per tCO2e, both rising 3%/yr. Auctioning phases in from FY2033.
source_label: Japan Ministry of the Environment — Press Release

price_note: article6_integration corrected from "Implemented" to "In Development": the domestic ACCU Scheme itself is real and operational, but no confirmed Article 6 cross-border authorization or DNA designation was found (see country notes). The Climate Change Authority's 5th ACCU Scheme review is still assessing Article 6 arrangements, due to report by end of 2026; an Aug 2026 Safeguard Mechanism review reportedly "dismisses international credit use for now".
source_label: Climate Change Authority — 2026 review of the ACCU Scheme

price_note: Targets an "Operational Phase" around late 2025/early 2026 after a 2020–2021 pilot and 2022–2025 transitional phase. Covers ~40% of national GHG emissions from large industrial/energy installations. Domestic offsets capped at 10% of compliance, with officials floating a rise to up to 100% depending on Mexico's updated NDC.
source_label: BDLaw — Mexico Carbon Markets Poised for Expansion in 2026

price_note: Green tax on stationary sources applies to companies emitting >25,000 tCO2e/year; the offsettable share (via carbon credits, including Article 6-eligible ones) has been expanding, with the Ministry of Energy aiming to double the carbon-tax liability payable in credits. article6_integration corrected from "In Development" to "Implemented": a Dec 2025 regulation reportedly operationalized Article 6 credit sales abroad, and Chile has authorized at least one real project (a coal-to-biomass conversion) under its Switzerland bilateral agreement.
source_label: Quantum Commodity Intelligence — Chile outlines Article 6 framework ahead of government change
